tasks.task: Find and shortlist creators who fit the brand

items.when: When a small brand needs the right creators found, scored for fit and ranked
When you have a niche and need a first list with follower counts, engagement and fit notes
When a creator looks good, to check who their audience is and whether it matches the buyer
When you need one account's positioning, themes and top posts before you approach them
When finding creators must become a weekly routine with roles and a method

tasks.task: Write outreach messages creators say yes to

items.when: When you have a creator in mind and need a first message and one follow-up in your voice
When the message must use the fit notes and offer agreed in the shortlist
When you want a different opening that a stranger can answer in one line, to compare
When the creators are on TikTok and you need what to offer and how to track replies
Before sending, to cut the message to one clear ask the creator can act on

tasks.task: Write a creator content brief with disclosure wording

items.when: When a creator or affiliate needs a one-page brief with claims, rights and disclosure wording
When a script is approved and the creator needs a filming brief, shoot order and file names
When the creator wants a suggested script, to offer five timed parts they can make their own
Before the brief goes out, to check viewers will remember the brand and not only the creator
When the brief lists claims creators may make, to sort each into fine, needs proof or cut

tasks.task: Plan product gifting to creators

items.when: When gifts go out with a phone-video script and a filming brief in the box
When gifting should feed a paid roster, with roster size and a pay rule
When the parcel needs an insert card and note with the cost checked against margin
Before the plan is agreed, to check the cost per gift against what a sale earns
When gifting is spray and pray and should put the sample in the right hands with a reason to try it

tasks.task: Set a fair fee or commission for a creator

items.when: When a creator asks for a fee and you need a fair flat fee or a floor-plus-commission offer
Before you offer any fee or rate, or when a partner asks for a higher one
When the margin per sale is not known and the ceiling would be a guess
When a creator pushes back on the rate and you need to hear their side before you counter

tasks.task: Check partner posts for labels, claims and links

items.when: When creators or affiliates have posted or sent drafts, before you pay or reuse the content
When you need the disclosure wording the post should have carried for that platform
When a post will run as a paid ad and must pass platform policy line by line
When a post makes health, money or results claims the brand cannot prove

tasks.task: Design an affiliate programme the business can afford

items.when: When you need commission, cookie window, payout rules and terms a small business can afford
When a business starts or restarts a programme and needs the steps in order
When you want a second design for rewards and flow to compare with yours
When the programme should start as one small test with costs and decision rules
When one big partner needs the profit sum and fair terms written out for them
When terms are drafted, to see what partners are really rewarded for and where it pulls wrong
When a reward looks generous, to ask how a partner could earn it without bringing a real sale

tasks.task: Work out the most a sale can pay a partner

items.when: Before you offer any commission, fee or referral reward
When the client is a shop and you need margin per sale after costs
When the product is a subscription and the ceiling depends on how long customers stay
When repeat orders should count and you need lifetime value and payback by cohort
When the partner also gets a discount code, to see what the code does to the margin

tasks.task: Design a customer refer-a-friend scheme

items.when: When happy customers should bring friends, with rewards you can afford and rules against abuse
When the reward sizes and terms must be checked against margin
When you want other ways to get customers talking, scored, before you settle on a reward
When the scheme should start as a small test with measures and a stop rule
When self-referrals and fake orders are a risk and you need fraud rules and a review routine
When the scheme pays people to share but gives them nothing worth saying

tasks.task: Write the affiliate partner kit

items.when: When terms are settled and partners need a welcome pack that helps them write and disclose well
When the kit needs approved claims and disclosure wording for each platform
When each partner needs tagged links and codes that match in the store's reports
When the welcome email is flat, to get a version that leads with what the partner gains
Before the kit goes out, to check every claim partners are told they may use

tasks.task: Recruit affiliates and content partners

items.when: When you need a ranked list of sites, newsletters and creators worth inviting
When partners are businesses and you need a qualified list with the reason for each
When each invite and follow-up must sound like the owner and be tied to the partner
When you want a shorter first message to test against the long invite

tasks.task: Review a programme from its export

items.when: When you have a network, tool or store export and need what each partner really brought
Monthly, timed to finish before the network's validation or lock date
When partners use codes and you need redemptions and revenue side by side
When a code looks busy, to see its real return against the margin given away
When partners use tagged links and you need revenue and orders by source
When the export and what customers say disagree, to find over-credited partners

tasks.task: Check payouts before they are approved

items.when: When commissions are due and returns, self-purchases and duplicates must come out first
When the check is one step in the month's run before the lock date
When each payout must be matched to the orders that funded it, with gaps flagged
When partners who left still have live codes that should be switched off

tasks.task: Set up links, codes and tracking for partners

items.when: When you need tagged links, match rules and a naming plan before partners go live
When events, names and tags must be written down for whoever sets them up
When partner sales overlap with ads and email and you must agree how credit is split

tasks.task: Pitch a partnership to another business

items.when: When you need partner ideas and a joint campaign plan with a pitch you can send
When you must first test whether partnerships are worth the time, with costs and measures
When the partner is interested and needs the profit sum and terms in writing
When you want a short cold opening to compare with the full pitch
Before sending, to cut the pitch to one clear ask
When you are pitching what you want and should start from who already has your buyers

tasks.task: Decide whether a paid sponsorship is worth it

items.when: When a creator, newsletter or podcast quotes a price and you need cost, fit and a decision
Before paying, to check the audience is who the seller says it is
When you need a fair number to counter with

tasks.task: Turn creator content into paid ads

items.when: When creator videos have views and you want ranked posts and checked scripts for ads
When posts are on TikTok and you must choose which to boost as partnered ads
Before any reuse, to confirm the brief gave usage rights for paid ads and for how long
Before creator videos run as ads, to confirm the product they show is in stock at the price they say

tasks.task: Run affiliates on TikTok Shop

items.when: When you need commission set-up, a creator outreach plan and sample rules for the shop
When you need to see which creators, videos and live shows made sales
Before setting open and targeted rates, to keep them under what a sale can pay

tasks.task: Plan a creator programme from scratch

items.when: When a business wants a creator programme, an affiliate programme or both
When you need one plan to find creators, set deals, brief them and track results
When customers might post for you, to compare that route with paid creators
When long videos exist and paying people per clip could beat paying per post
When long recordings must be cut into captioned clips for partners to post
Before the programme is set, to compare two plans that split the budget between gifting, fees and commission

tasks.task: Review a creator or affiliate agreement

items.when: When a creator or network sends a contract and you need key clauses and risks rated
When usage rights, review steps and timelines in the brief must match the agreement

always.when: Before any brief or kit that must look and sound like the client
When anything partners will repeat states a result or number you cannot trace to proof
Before a brief, kit or terms go to partners, to catch typos and names spelt two ways

helpers.when: When creator videos need scripts, hooks and a test plan as paid ads
When partnered content must be run and budgeted in an ad account
When the programme runs inside TikTok Shop with listings and live shows
When payouts must be posted and reconciled in the books
When disclosure, tax forms or contract terms need a rules check
When partner sales must be untangled from ads and email

gaps: No library item writes disclosure wording by platform and country or checks a post's label; only the kit covers it
No library item writes affiliate programme terms: cookie window, payout rules, banned methods and ending the deal
No library item reviews an affiliate network export for returns, self-purchases and coupon-site poaching
No library item writes a creator agreement or usage-rights terms; the contract reviewers found are general
No library item checks a creator for fake followers or bought engagement
No library item gives a rate card or benchmark for creator fees by platform and audience size
No library item writes a partner welcome kit or a monthly partner newsletter
No library item recruits affiliates such as review sites, newsletters and coupon partners
No library item checks a refer-a-friend scheme for abuse before launch
No library item tests whether partner sales would have happened anyway
No library item gives clearly different creator briefs or gifting plans to compare
